rows.averse: The void as mere vacancy. Folly without innocence; aimless spirit; dissipation into the unformed.

rows.power: Miracles of healing, gift of tongues, knowledge of sciences
rows.averse: The Magus as con-man. Language turned to lies; skill used to deceive; the juggler who palms the truth.

rows.power: The white tincture, clairvoyance, divination by dreams
rows.averse: The veil become a wall. Barren secrecy, sterile moon, fixation on the hidden for its own sake.
Fertility inverted: the devouring mother. Flesh without love; Venus as appetite.
Hope inverted: the false light, the sterile star. Vision that leads nowhere; consecration of the profane.
rows.trump: XVII The Star (Crowley/Grant) · IV The Emperor (GD)

rows.averse: Dogma as tyranny. Hollow ritual, false initiation; the nail that fixes instead of joins.

rows.power: Being in two or more places at once; prophecy
rows.averse: Division: the sword that only cuts apart. Broken union, paralysis of choice, the twin that betrays.
The vehicle without a driver. Momentum with no control; armour that has become a prison.
Appetite unbridled. Ecstasy that consumes; the Beast without the Woman riding it.
Isolation and sterility. The seed unsown; the lamp hoarded; light that never leaves the cell.

rows.power: Power of acquiring political and other ascendancy
rows.averse: Fatalism: the wheel as a cage. Luck divorced from will; rise and fall with no lesson.
Injustice: the unbalanced scale. Karma as vengeance; judgment with no measure.
Drowning. Surrender become stagnation; the waters of the Abyss closing over the head.
Putrefaction with no renewal. Death fixated upon; the scorpion that stings itself.

rows.power: Transmutations; vision of the Universal Peacock
rows.averse: Failed alchemy. Forces mixed that should not mix; poison instead of elixir; the arrow that falls short.

rows.power: The Witches' Sabbath (so called); the Evil Eye
rows.averse: Bondage: matter taken as the whole. The goat with no eye above it; the joke nobody gets.
Destruction without renewal. War, ruin, catastrophe; the mouth that only curses.
Tyranny: authority without legitimacy. Sterile rule; the hook that holds but does not feed.
rows.trump: IV The Emperor (Crowley/Grant) · XVII The Star (GD)

rows.averse: Illusion and sorcery. Nightmare, the dark tide, the path that doubles back; fear in the reptile brain.

rows.power: The red tincture; power of acquiring wealth
rows.averse: The black sun. Glare that blinds; vanity; false enlightenment; the face with nothing behind it.
Fire that annihilates rather than transforms. False judgment; apocalypse as an end, not a birth.
Matter as tomb. Imprisonment in form; the Universe as dead end; the cross with no resurrection.
